title: Egg Bowl shuttles link Oxford’s Square and Jackson Avenue to campus
excerpt: Oxford’s free game-day buses run Friday for the 11 a.m. Egg Bowl. Fans can ride from the downtown parking garage to the Student Union or from the Jackson Avenue Center to Kennon Observatory.
locality: Regional reader service for Pontotoc County fans traveling to Oxford, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc fans heading to Oxford for Friday’s Egg Bowl can ride a free shuttle from the downtown parking garage to the Ole Miss Student Union. Oxford-University Transit will switch to game-day service Nov. 27, when Ole Miss and Mississippi State kick off at 11 a.m. Central at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium.

Fans coming through the Square can use the Downtown Square Shuttle, which also stops at North Lamar and Adams. A second option, the JAC game-day shuttle, connects the east and west stops at the Jackson Avenue Center with Kennon Observatory on campus.

For a trip earlier in the week, the transit agency lists Wednesday service from 6 a.m. to 5:45 p.m. and a Thanksgiving Day closure. Riders can find live bus tracking through the agency’s website or call 662-234-3540 for route information.
For those watching from home, ABC will carry the game live. This is the 123rd meeting in the rivalry, according to Ole Miss Athletics.
